discovery.hypothesis: Tampa Bay put Brayden Point on injured reserve with no timeline, and 20-year-old O'Reilly could make his NHL debut. Tampa also plays at Columbus on Thursday, so tonight is the first night of a back-to-back. CBS listed Buffalo as a slight home underdog (+106, total 6.5). If the current price hasn't moved enough to account for Point's absence, Buffalo is worth a look. Puck drop is listed for 7:10 PM EST Wednesday, but outlets disagree: NHL.com says 7 p.m. ET and ESPN says 7:30 PM.
discovery.question: Has the line already moved to account for Point being out? Who are the confirmed starting goalies? Does Tampa's lineup without Point actually leave its top six much weaker?
